tooltip.ninjacatskies.thread_of_return.h: Spend it before the pool empties — a Clowder at zero is already spectating.
message.ninjacatskies.thread_of_return.l: Shared lives are switched off on this world.
message.ninjacatskies.thread_of_return.n: No Clowder to credit. Join or make a team first.
tooltip.ninjacatskies.strand_token: Seat it at a Tension Post. Spares are souvenirs, not fuel.
tooltip.ninjacatskies.codex_page: Right-click to read the margin. Pages are kept, not spent.
tooltip.ninjacatskies.codex.book: Right-click: Start here. Grave (`): assignment list and rewards.

tooltip.ninjacatskies.codex.quests: Right-click: Start here. Grave (`): assignment list and rewards.
tooltip.ninjacatskies.cache_lore: Provisions set aside by the Nine Tribes.
tooltip.ninjacatskies.cache_small: 4 parcels: 2 supplies (sometimes copper, iron or Thread), 1 from the garden (saplings, seeds, crops, flowers, maybe a farm animal egg) and 1 decoration.
tooltip.ninjacatskies.cache_medium: 8 parcels: 5 supplies (often ingots, redstone and Thread), 2 from the garden with a wider choice of animal eggs, and 1 decoration.
tooltip.ninjacatskies.cache_large: 17 parcels: 12 supplies (ingots, books, experience, a chance of diamonds, emeralds, pearls or a Thread Skein), 3 from the garden and 2 decorations.
tooltip.ninjacatskies.cache_open: Use to unwrap. Supplies can repeat. No machines. A small chance of a Thread Shard, and a very small one of a Thread of Return.
message.ninjacatskies.cache_empty: The cache could not open. Its supplies table is empty; the seal is kept.
message.ninjacatskies.post_locked: The Post is locked by redstone.
message.ninjacatskies.end_apple.away: The apple pulls you through the Cut.
message.ninjacatskies.end_apple.home: The last bite carries you home.
message.ninjacatskies.end_apple.already_: You are already there. Save it for the way back.
message.ninjacatskies.end_apple.no_end: Nothing answers: this world has no End.
message.ninjacatskies.end_apple.no_way_b: The way back is gone; ask an operator for a lift.
message.ninjacatskies.strand.soil.line_a: Soil answers. Pad-keepers banked hearth-warmth in dirt this thin, and it held.
message.ninjacatskies.strand.soil.line_b: Claim the pad. Cache what grows. Wake slowly; the void is patient.
message.ninjacatskies.strand.stone.line_: Stone hums under the mesh. Grit-singers named every shard by its echo.
Shatter grit. Knot yarn. Recover what the cut scattered.
message.ninjacatskies.strand.sprout.line: Sprout takes hold. Rootbinders grew living anchors where pads would have drifted.
Feed the Clowder before you feed the forge. Root, then wander.
message.ninjacatskies.strand.claw.line_a: Claw finds the rim. Edge-walkers kept footholds past the last fence post.
message.ninjacatskies.strand.claw.line_b: Kit up. Step off the pad on purpose, never by accident.
message.ninjacatskies.strand.spark.line_: Spark wakes a pulse. Drumhearts kept the beat under the whole sky.
Strike a drum and listen before you wire anything.
message.ninjacatskies.strand.clock.line_: Clock repeats. Pattern-weavers sang a factory the way you'd sing a round.
One cog, then the same cog again. Let the pattern carry the work.
message.ninjacatskies.strand.swarm.line_: Swarm thickens. Colony-keepers tended hives that hummed in the Loom's own key.
Keep something alive that keeps something else alive. That is industry.
message.ninjacatskies.strand.sigil.line_: Sigil bites. Seal-carvers pressed spirit into matter and made it stay.
Carve carefully. A seal is a promise the world has to keep.
message.ninjacatskies.strand.spindle.lin: Spindle draws taut. Loom-stitchers cut the gate-paths and always meant to come back.
Stitch the cut. Then go and see what the March kept for you.
message.ninjacatskies.page.soil.note_1: We never called it dirt. We called it what was left, and we kept it warm.
message.ninjacatskies.page.soil.note_2: A pad holds because someone decided it would. Decide daily.
message.ninjacatskies.page.soil.note_3: Plant the sapling before you are hungry. Hunger makes poor gardeners.
message.ninjacatskies.page.stone.note_1: Every shard has a note. Iron is low and patient. Gold barely bothers to answer.
message.ninjacatskies.page.stone.note_2: The mesh does not find the ore. The mesh gives the ore somewhere to land.
message.ninjacatskies.page.stone.note_3: Yarn from the void is not magic. It is thread that remembers where it came from.
message.ninjacatskies.page.sprout.note_1: Roots are the only rope the void respects.
message.ninjacatskies.page.sprout.note_2: Feed the pad and the pad feeds the Clowder. That is the whole treaty.
message.ninjacatskies.page.sprout.note_3: A seed you can grow twice is worth more than an ingot you can grow once.
message.ninjacatskies.page.claw.note_1: The rim is not the edge of the world. It is the edge of your attention.
message.ninjacatskies.page.claw.note_2: Boots first. Then the bridge. Then the courage; it arrives on its own.
message.ninjacatskies.page.claw.note_3: We left footholds so nobody would have to be brave in the same place twice.
message.ninjacatskies.page.spark.note_1: Power is a rhythm before it is a number.
message.ninjacatskies.page.spark.note_2: The drum is not loud. The drum is steady. Be the drum.
message.ninjacatskies.page.spark.note_3: An orphan engine still hums. Listen to it before you feed it.
message.ninjacatskies.page.clock.note_1: A factory is a song that has stopped needing the singer.
message.ninjacatskies.page.clock.note_2: Make one thing well. Then teach the cogs to make it without you.
message.ninjacatskies.page.clock.note_3: Every belt is a thread. Every gear is a knot. You already know this craft.
message.ninjacatskies.page.swarm.note_1: You do not own a hive. You are on good terms with it.
message.ninjacatskies.page.swarm.note_2: Living industry forgives mistakes that machines do not.
message.ninjacatskies.page.swarm.note_3: The March had flowers that hummed back. We miss them most at dusk.
message.ninjacatskies.page.sigil.note_1: A seal is a promise you carve so the world has to keep it.
message.ninjacatskies.page.sigil.note_2: Never bind what you would not be willing to unbind.
message.ninjacatskies.page.sigil.note_3: Spirit goes where it is asked politely and stays where it is fed.
message.ninjacatskies.page.spindle.note_: We cut the gate-paths. We always meant to come back and mend them.
The Loom was never one thread. It was nine agreeing.
When you reach the March, tell it we are sorry it took so long.
message.ninjacatskies.codex.nudge.soil: Soil first. Wood, dirt, a bench, a sapling. Claim the pad and let it hold you.
message.ninjacatskies.codex.nudge.stone: Stone: unravel Thread to string, spin Void Yarn, tie a Binding Knot. Then let the mesh catch grit.
message.ninjacatskies.codex.nudge.sprout: Sprout: a field, a kitchen, a first Inferium row. Feed the Clowder before the forge.
message.ninjacatskies.codex.nudge.claw: Claw: blueprints, iron on your back, a way off the pad that you chose.
message.ninjacatskies.codex.nudge.spark: Spark: strike a Drumheart and hold a Pulse before you touch a wire.
message.ninjacatskies.codex.nudge.clock: Clock: one cog, then the same cog again. Let Create carry the pattern.
message.ninjacatskies.codex.nudge.swarm: Swarm: keep something alive that keeps something else alive. Bees, deep crops.
message.ninjacatskies.codex.nudge.sigil: Sigil: two braid paths make a cord. Then carve seals and ask the stewards' rites.
message.ninjacatskies.codex.nudge.spindl: Spindle: a digital loom, a March stone, and the Post. Stitch the cut.
message.ninjacatskies.tension.post_intro: A Tension Post. Seat Strand tokens here as the Clowder tensions them.
message.ninjacatskies.tension.other_clow: This Post answers to another Clowder.
message.ninjacatskies.tension.already_te: %s is already tensioned here. Keep the spare as proof.
message.ninjacatskies.tension.cord_short: A cord wants %s filaments in hand. %s short.
message.ninjacatskies.tension.braided: Sixteen filaments take the braid. The post holds it taut.
message.ninjacatskies.tension.fragment_s: March stone against nine Strands. The Spindle spins a Fragment.
message.ninjacatskies.tension.fragment_n: The Spindle needs every Strand seated before it will take March stone.
message.ninjacatskies.tension.already_re: Your Clowder has already rewoven its sky.
message.ninjacatskies.tension.fragment_t: Nine Strands first. Then the Fragment.
message.ninjacatskies.tension.rewoven_he: Rewoven. The cut is closed above this pad.
message.ninjacatskies.basket.not_yours: %s's yarn basket. It is not yours to unpick.
message.ninjacatskies.basket.waiting: Your things wait in a Yarn Basket at %s, %s, %s.
message.ninjacatskies.basket.waiting_dim: Your things wait in a Yarn Basket at %s, %s, %s in %s.
message.ninjacatskies.command.lives_disa: Soft hardcore lives are disabled in config.
message.ninjacatskies.join.welcome: Skybound. The Loom is cut. Codex: Start here. Soil first.
message.ninjacatskies.join.charter: Island Charter in hand — Dock: Create Team. Pad chests restore kits after claim.
message.ninjacatskies.lives.exhausted: Your Clowder has spent its last life. A rare life reward or an operator revive can restore the pool.
message.ninjacatskies.lives.thread_award: A Thread of Return: +1 shared Clowder life. Remaining: %s
message.ninjacatskies.lives.thread_spent: %s spends a Thread of Return: +1 shared Clowder life. Remaining: %s
message.ninjacatskies.codex.all_answer: Every Strand answers. Seat the Fragment and go see the March.
message.ninjacatskies.codex.thins: The Codex thins to a point.
message.ninjacatskies.codex.progress: %s of nine tensioned. Grave (`): remaining quests. Tokens to the Post.
message.ninjacatskies.codex.start: Open Start here. Grave (`): quests. Raise a Tension Post when the first token comes.
tooltip.ninjacatskies.codex.damaged: Damaged, but it still assigns work.
message.ninjacatskies.tension.all_answer: Every Strand answers. The Spindle waits for a March stone.
message.ninjacatskies.tension.page_slips: A Codex Page slips free — a %s margin note.
message.ninjacatskies.tension.reward_thr: The Loom returns a little Thread. Root is holding.
message.ninjacatskies.tension.reward_pag: Two pages the stewards never finished. Read them anyway.
message.ninjacatskies.tension.reward_bin: Bind is close. The post hums loud enough to feel in your teeth.
message.ninjacatskies.tension.reweave_br: The Loom-stitchers' cut is closed. %s has rewoven their Strand of the sky.
message.ninjacatskies.tension.reweave_me: Nine tribes, one thread. Go and see what the March kept for you.
message.ninjacatskies.tension.edge_footi: Edge-walker footing. The pad caught you.
